The reported microstructure of the 9Al-10Mn-0.4C alloy (only partial discontinuous precipitation of austenite into γ + κ lamellar structures, the reaction starting at the grain boundaries; Fig. 1(a) and Fig. 2(a)) is measured after 600 °C tempering and therefore belongs to the 600 °C tempered sample, not to this as-hot-rolled (1150 °C) sample. The paper additionally states the 9Al-10Mn-0.4C alloy did not undergo austenite decomposition during tempering at 800 °C.
